story_details.description: Implement canonical ingestion of all Workspace docs with proper domain/tag/flag/semantic_family classification. Establishes hybrid plane architecture: System plane (jarvis-core) vs Corpus plane.
story_details.business_value: Foundation for Jarvis semantic operating system. Enables clean separation between "how Jarvis thinks" (system) and "what Jarvis knows" (corpus). Prevents system leakage into normal QA while preserving introspection capability.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ingest_workspace_docs.py classifies all docs with domain/tags/meta/semantic_family
docs/jarvis/* marked as System Plane: is_system=true, semantic_family=core-memory
docs/jarvis/playbooks/* marked as Corpus Plane: is_system=false, semantic_family=playbook
docs/archive/* marked as stale: is_latest=false, semantic_family=archive

artifact.purpose: Classify and ingest all Workspace docs with canonical taxonomy

failure_mode.name: System Leakage into Normal QA
failure_mode.risk: If _build_filter forgets must_not(is_system=true), user gets raw internal spec in normal QA
failure_mode.mitigation: Unit test: assert is_system excluded in QA mode
Answer composition: drop/downweight jarvis-core in normal QA

failure_mode.name: Inability to Introspect
failure_mode.risk: Over-filter makes it impossible to answer "summarise memory.core.md"

test.name: Normal Domain QA
test.query: Explain the hydrogen water loop concept in GD

test.name: Architecture QA
test.query: How is Jarvis's memory architecture designed?
test.expected: architecture docs, maybe epic-4.5, NOT memory.core

test.name: Historical Plan
test.query: What was the original PRD for Jarvis before Epic 4?

test.name: Session Introspection
test.query: What happened in the BREAKTHROUGH session on 2025-12-03?

story_context.notes: Vision, not Ultron. System plane = how Jarvis thinks. Corpus plane = what Jarvis knows. semantic_family is the hook for next-stage cognitive governance.
